subject: [PATCH v3 14/18] selftests/mm: verify synchronous khugepaged driving is attributable

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch adds a selftest to verify that synchronous khugepaged driving produces deterministic and attributable results. The test uses tracepoints to attribute outcomes and checks that exactly one collapse attempt is made on the source pages of each prepared window, and that the window is collapsed afterwards. The test sets scan_sleep_millisecs high to ensure the sysfs store wakes the daemon in time. The patch passes 5/5 tests on x86-64 4K and arm64 64K architectures.
